report.speaker: Rémi Rhodes and Vincent Vargas
report.title: Two Decades of Probabilistic Approach to Liouville Conformal Field Theory
report.question: 如何把分布值随机场的指数面积构造成严格 Liouville 相关函数，并通过边界拼接、连续谱和 DOZZ 三点数据重建曲面振幅？

rhodes-vargas-icm2026: Entire publisher HTML mathematical body §§1–9, every displayed formula and all figure captions, in overlapping section-sized reads (lines 90–602); acknowledgments 603–604 and footnote 609. Selected relevant bibliography entries only, not the complete bibliography. Metadata/title/authors/DOI/pages/license and online date verified, lines 59–65 and 1196–1246. No publisher PDF or figure-pixel inspection. Subsequent checks re-read §§3–8 normalization, hypotheses and typographical discrepancies.

dozz-v3: Selected full text: §2.2–2.4 (extracted lines 470–585), §4.2 (830–890), §5.2 (1230–1295, including start of §6 only), Appendix §12.1 and Corollary 12.2 (3548–3600). PDF p.13 rendered and visually inspected for both negative degenerate weights. RV-F09 repair additionally read §1.2, (1.11) and following continuation/zeros paragraph (lines 248–292, PDF p.5), and §12.5, (12.7) and following zeros paragraph (lines 3763–3797, PDF p.53); both pages rendered and visually inspected for the integral, shifts, powers and zero sets. Remaining sections not read in full.
bootstrap-v2: Selected §§1.3–1.5 (lines 342–488), §2.3 (587–627), Proposition 5.5 statement and opening proof (2110–2155), §7.5 formula (7.36) and Proposition 7.12 (5072–5103), §8.1 and start of §8.2 (5198–5234). segal-v2: Selected §2.1.1–2.1.3 (760–850), §3.1.2–3.1.3 (1040–1098), Theorem 4.4 and bound (1860–1915), Propositions 5.1/5.2 and gluing constants (2190–2260), §10.1 selected local Green proof excerpt (4350–4400), Appendix C statement and proof excerpt (6371–6465). 4J01.scope: 等温坐标推导曲率变换；Gauss–Bonnet 复用，明确标量曲率为高斯曲率两倍。

4J02.scope: 闭曲面变分、曲率代入及两解相减的能量唯一性；经典 Q=2/gamma。

4J03.scope: 完成平方，含协方差因子及指数归一化。

4J04.scope: 引用一般闭曲面谱基与 Weyl 定律，逐项二阶矩和 Tonelli 证明负阶收敛及 covariance=2pi G。

4J05.scope: 谱 zeta 的全平面亚纯延拓和零点正则性引用；有限乘积类比直接计算。

4J06.scope: 高斯矩恒等式与两种正则化的有限方差密度；不丢确定性因子。

4J07.scope: 0<gamma<2，固定测地圆平均，弱收敛、非退化和唯一性引用 GMC 理论；圆平均单独构造。

4J08.scope: 高斯两点矩和二维极坐标可积性给出 gamma^2<2；不以此证明整个次临界区间。

4J09.scope: gamma,mu,Z>0，a>0 时精确换元；a<=0 的负尾发散；随机 Z 段再次明确 a>0。

4J0A.scope: 参数、曲率线性项、自由场行列式和 GMC 势的完整概率定义；不假设总质量自动有限。

4J0B.scope: 共同正则化定义；固定尺度应用场级 Cameron–Martin，奇异混沌极限引用严格 Seiberg 区域的研究定理。

4J0C.scope: 所有 alpha_j<Q、sum alpha>Q chi；全局条件由 Gamma 积分证明，局部混沌与负矩界引用；零与发散分开。

4J0D.scope: 完整 c_L/(96pi) 反常、点权与微分同胚自然性引用；常数缩放直接计算。

4J0E.scope: Delta_alpha=alpha(2Q-alpha)/4，Delta_gamma=1、谱线值及 c_L>25 直接计算。

4J0F.scope: 明确圆度量，Möbius 距离恒等式与三重传递性；C=C0*C_DOZZ 仅用于此度量，常数缩放反常显式。

4J0G.scope: 零端抵消、无穷端指数衰减、紧子集全纯性、中心归一化；全局结果移至 1G。

4J0H.scope: 保持全部 Upsilon 参数、幂指数、mu 因子与报告 C0；证明所需 BPZ/解析延拓/反射识别明确引用。

4J0I.scope: 抽屉原理产生趋零周期，再用整数倍逼近任意位移和连续性。

4J0J.scope: Witt 交换子直接计算，中心项和 Jacobi 多项式核验。

4J0K.scope: 最高权/Verma/分拆定义及 L0 交换计算；共同双主态权为 h,k，只有 h=k 才有 2h。

4J0L.scope: 按第二变量线性约定逐交换子计算一级、二级所有元素与行列式。

4J0M.scope: L1,L2 及更高模式消去计算；商模中向量可以已为零；-gamma/2,-2/gamma 的出处与报告符号差异明确。

4J0N.scope: 完整列明 L-1、L-2 插入和消去假设，代入得二阶方程；未声称代数关系自动证明概率 BPZ。

4J0O.scope: Fourier 规范、负阶均方收敛、对数弦长协方差以及 dc 乘积边界测度。

4J0P.scope: 平滑边界 Fourier 延拓与 2pi sum |n||f_n|^2 能量；粗糙高斯边界不具有限能量。

4J0Q.scope: 证明 G 可测 L² 子空间闭，引用投影定理，给积分刻画；条件独立移至 1J。

4J0R.scope: 平滑有界 D 与内区域 U，独立 Dirichlet 场加随机调和部分；有限能量正交计算不充当连续场存在性证明。

4J0S.scope: In/Out 方向、精确圆柱 collar 度量、反演相容性与 Euler 数。

4J0T.scope: 连通可容许曲面、每点 alpha<Q、sum alpha>Q chi；报告归一化的拼接，未标记圆环明确排除在 HS 结论外。

4J0U.scope: Cauchy–Schwarz 与 Fubini 给乘积范数界，说明复内积的共轭约定。

4J0V.scope: 规范化有界圆环算子及强连续性引用；长度相加、生成元定义与 H 非中心的交换计算。

4J0W.scope: 初始稠密定义域为 C_c∞(c) 与有限高斯坐标多项式的代数张量积；Hermite 完备性引用，导数平方可积、边界项消失、分部积分能量恒等式和形式可闭性局部证明；闭形式表示定理指定自伴实现。

4J0X.scope: 随机变量阈值与 L² 阈值分开；更大耦合改用场配置空间的奇异势形式。

4J0Y.scope: 形式定义域、闭性、D(H) 与作用完整列明；Liouville 全 0<gamma<2 的构造引用 Proposition 5.5。

4J0Z.scope: 谱区间、能量、p>0 和 1/(2pi)、两套逆 Gram、广义系数与第二变量线性约定；散射完整性引用。

4J10.scope: 有限维系数 b=Fa 与正定性；推广到子空间投影，未由此推出连续谱完整性。

4J11.scope: alpha<Q 的精确公式，Pphi 已含零模态；加权解析延拓和后裔定理引用；非 HS 与内积全纯性约定明确。

4J12.scope: 精确 Gamma 比、正底数幂、排除集合引用；共轭 Gamma 与两次反射恒等式证明；(7.12)按解析延拓理解。

4J13.scope: 引用 Ward 分析定理；单次微分、无穷远归一化和 W_nu 乘积直接证明；源文两种乘积次序明确换算。

4J14.scope: 每层双指标收缩、一级系数、二级向量、q=z/2 与报告幂因子；不把形式定义等同收敛。

4J15.scope: 严格成对条件、0<|z|<1、0,z,2,infinity、平坦插入邻域、圆柱 collar、inversion 对称、g(0)=1；C(g)保留，度量指数据 Theorem 8.1。

4J16.scope: 四个成对不等式、0<q<1；在原论文去度量的 1/(8pi) 规范中比较两次定理，不混用报告 C(g)。

4J17.scope: 给定裤子分解后的 Euler 加法与边界计数；不另证明曲面分类。

4J18.scope: (2pi)^-3、R_+³、DOZZ 绝对值平方、三组逆 Gram 与几何 Cprime；只断言几乎处处块收敛。

4J19.scope: 系数指数界充分条件与 n! 反例；报告中的环面 AGT 仅作为形式结果，不升级为解析收敛。

4J1A.scope: 正形状参数、有限正负矩假设下联合换元证明独立性，面积均值方差及 mu 缩放。

4J1B.scope: 报告 (6.1) 的 v/fprime、复共轭系数及共同定义域限制；沿 r=e^-t 的链式法则直接计算。

4J1C.scope: 以 C² 解及函数和导数两端渐近为假设，证明 Im(conj(psi)psi prime) 守恒；不证明散射解存在性。

4J1G.scope: 两种步长、Gamma商、正底数幂、完整零点集合和无理b²简单性；不伪称从条带积分已证明全部延拓。

remaining_branches.branch: Boundary LCFT and exact one-dimensional GMC formulas
remaining_branches.scope: Report §9 context retained; full boundary structure constants, Fyodorov–Bouchaud and interval laws, and annulus random modulus not developed as additional theorem pages.
Introductory motivation and §9 directions acknowledged; no full planar-map scaling, mating-of-trees or percolation-exponent proofs claimed.

Local geometric factor and almost-everywhere block convergence retained. Full Teichmuller line bundle, Schwarzian cocycle, projective mapping-class representation and Verlinde equivalence not constructed. Correspondence remains conjectural in the report.

remaining_branches.branch: AGT, JT gravity, Toda, H3-WZW and imaginary Liouville
remaining_branches.scope: Report §9 is a dated source survey. Formal/analytic distinction expanded in 4J19; JT semiclassical claims and general bootstrap extensions are not promoted to proved universal statements or current-status surveys.
Extended analytic continuation and critical renormalizations not developed; fourpoint formula restricted to stated pair-charge inequalities.

unexpanded_deep_proofs.scope: Compact elliptic spectral basis, Weyl law, and spectral-zeta meromorphic continuation are precisely quoted standard theorems. Green local remainder and Gaussian Sobolev convergence are separately proved.

Full subcritical GMC existence/nondegeneracy, singular negative moments, simultaneous vertex limits and general Weyl anomaly are cited. Circle averages, finite/Gaussian-field shifts and zero-mode calculation are local.

DOZZ integrability, probabilistic BPZ decoupling, reflection identification, parameter analytic continuation and global Upsilon theorem not reproved. Algebraic null-vector calculation and conditional BPZ implication are local.

Continuous domain Markov construction, determinant gluing, full Segal amplitudes, projective annulus representation and operator differentiability are cited. Conditional expectation, kernel contraction and radial calculation are local.

Singular interaction form at larger coupling, self-adjoint realization, scattering completeness, weighted analytic continuation and exact reflection coefficient are cited; bounded self-adjoint spectral theorem is not substituted.

Analytic Ward identities, holomorphic factorization, block convergence almost everywhere and justified spectral integrals are cited. Ward coefficient arithmetic, inverse Gram algebra, topology counts and conditional crossing consequence are local.

metadata.coverage: All main mathematical report sections §§3–8 developed; §§1–2 motivation and §9 context integrated, with specialized side branches explicitly deferred.
metadata.shared_integration: Parent-owned; no shared registry, navigation, theme, tests, build, commit or push performed.
conventions: Positive Laplacian -div grad; scalar curvature twice Gaussian curvature; covariance 2pi G in report, whereas Segal G already includes 2pi.
Existing forest second-variable-linear convention used throughout; bra/ket holomorphic dependence translated rather than copied from the report.
Report descending descendant product differs from bootstrap v2 reversed product. Ward polynomial and Gram basis are changed together; the scalar contraction is basis-invariant.
